title: Efficient oxidative degradation of organic pollutants in real industrial effluents using a green-synthesized magnetite supported on biochar catalyst
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31522-31538
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04070A, Paper
Open Access

Mohamed Mohamed Gaber, Arafat Toghan, Hassan Shokry, Mahmoud Samy
This study investigated the degradation of tetracycline antibiotic via catalytic activation of periodate using a novel composite catalyst composed of green-synthesized magnetite nanoparticles supported on water lettuce-derived biochar.
